verdict: SK Hynix ships HBM4E samples 6 months early (+7% to record); TrendForce flips 2027 HBM to 'multiples higher' — baseline correction thesis challenged; MU June 24 earnings next catalyst. Tone: bull.
body_md:
## Fresh developments (last 24-72h)

**SK Hynix ships 12-layer HBM4E samples — TODAY (June 18)** — timeline pulled ~6 months forward from prior H2 guidance. 16 Gbps/pin, +20% power efficiency, 48 GB in 12-hi stack shipped to major AI customers. SK Hynix shares surged ~7% to an all-time record high (₩2.697M KRW); South Korea's KOSPI broke 9,000 for the first time in history. Samsung racing to match the shipment timeline.

**TrendForce (June 2): 2027 HBM ASPs to surge "multiples higher"** — as buyer-supplier negotiations shift to 2027 HBM4 long-term agreements, TrendForce's latest report flips the 2027 pricing tone sharply bullish, directly challenging the baseline "correction phase after 2026" risk signal. NVIDIA Rubin Ultra (2027) requires 384 GB HBM per GPU; Google TPU volumes and AWS Trainium3 further amplify 2027 bit demand.

**DRAM pricing: Q1 2026 industry revenue +81% QoQ confirmed (TrendForce June 1); Q2 tracking +58–63% QoQ DRAM / +70–75% NAND** — slight deceleration from Q1's record pace, but memflation remains exceptional. Novel alert: DDR5 64GB RDIMM profitability overtook HBM profitability in Q1 2026 for the first time — a shift that could redirect supplier wafer allocation away from HBM, incrementally tightening HBM supply.

**AVGO Q2 FY2026 (June 3): AI revenue $10.8B (+143% YoY); Q3 guided $16.0B AI (+200% YoY)** — reaffirmed $56B FY2026 and $100B FY2027 AI targets. Initial chip-sector whiplash: NVDA −7%, MU −11.5%, MRVL −13% after AVGO declined to raise its long-term AI outlook on earnings day. Market has partially re-absorbed those moves as Q3 guide of $16B reads as strong.

**FSLR / Solar: Section 232 tariff decision expected by end of June** — solar stocks up 40% YTD. FSLR at a multiyear high; UBS raised target to $330, citing tariff tailwind. Higher tariffs on imported modules would lift FSLR domestic ASPs directly.

| SK Hynix (MU proxy) | +7% to record high today | HBM4E 12-hi samples officially shipped June 18 |
| MU | +8% June 15, ~$1,059 | Cowen raises target +127%; Q3 earnings catalyst June 24 |
| MRVL | +14.6% this week | B. Riley raises to $345 from $240 (June 12); custom ASIC + networking wins |
| FSLR | At multiyear high | Section 232 announcement imminent; UBS $330 target |

No notable movers today: NVDA, AMD, COHR, LITE, CIEN, ENPH, NXT, ARRY, HIVE, ALAB, CRDO, WDC, SNDK, STX, RMBS, MRAM, NOW, ZS, CRM, SNOW, TSLA, GDDY, NOK, AMPX, ALMU.

## Context vs. baseline

The baseline's central correction risk ("HBM prices could enter a correction phase after 2026") is being directly challenged: (a) TrendForce June 2 calls 2027 HBM ASPs "multiples higher"; (b) HBM4E sample timeline pulled 6 months forward. Hyperscaler capex has risen above baseline to ~$690–725B vs. the $600–700B baseline forecast. The correction thesis required three-supplier capacity to complete in late 2026; NVIDIA Rubin Ultra (384 GB HBM) + growing hyperscaler demand may outrun supply well into 2027. DDR5 profitability eclipsing HBM for the first time is a new signal: if sustained, it shifts wafer mix and creates incremental HBM tightness.

## Signals flashing

| Signal | Direction | Bull/Bear |
|--------|-----------|-----------|
| 1. DRAM/HBM pricing | Q2 +58–63% QoQ; Q1 rev +81% QoQ | Bull — memflation sustained, modest decel |
| 2. HBM4 ramp/capacity | HBM4E ships today, 6 months early | Bull — post-2026 correction thesis pushed out |
| 3. Hyperscaler capex | ~$690–725B, no guide-downs; Meta raised guidance | Bull |
| 4. AMD/Custom ASIC | MI400/Helios on track for Q3 2026; MRVL $11B ASIC 2026 rev | Bull |
| 5. Optical/photonics | LITE sole 200G EML supplier at volume; COHR CPO demos; no fresh catalyst today | Neutral |
| 6. Solar | Section 232 tariff decision imminent; FSLR at multiyear high | Bull — near-term catalyst pending |
| 7. Watchlist catalysts | MU June 24 earnings key; MRVL upgrade momentum; FSLR at breakout level | Bull |

## Most important development

**SK Hynix officially ships 12-layer HBM4E samples today, stock +7% to all-time record** — the 6-month timeline pull-forward, combined with TrendForce's June 2 call for 2027 HBM prices to surge "multiples higher," is the top signal this week and directly pushes back the baseline's central risk scenario. The entire memory-HBM-AI supply chain reads bullish. **MU's June 24 earnings report is the next major near-term watchlist catalyst** — watch for HBM4 ramp confirmation and Q3 revenue/margin guidance.

*Not investment advice. Forward figures are forecasts.*
